[tunzafun001] Ok, I'm a router numpty.
Just got NBN 500. Speed is tested at 500mbit via cable.
42mbit via 2.4ghz
240mbit via 5ghz
Router is a gigabit router .. but
AI suggests the CPU in the wifi router is realistically maxed at 240mbits.
Does this thing have a faster CPU? / Faster than what I have?
[MasterYeeter] What is your current router? What speed do you get on 5GHz when standing right in front of the router? If you still get 240mbps, then upgrading to this router will increase your wifi speeds.
If you get the full 500mbps on 5GHz when standing in front of the router, your speed drop is happening due to weak wifi signal and probably won't be fixed by just upgrading to this router. You'll need to setup a mesh wifi system with 2-3 devices around the house in places with weak wifi signals.
If you'd like to setup a wifi mesh system:
Router is the main device connected to the nbn box
Satellite is the second wifi device that connects to the router via wifi (or ethernet if you can run a cable between them)
If you can run an ethernet cable between the router and the satellites, you can get a cheap dual-band wifi mesh system and get close to 500mbps wifi everywhere.
If you can't run ethernet cables and get a dual-band wifi mesh system, on 5GHz wifi you can get close to 500mbps if connected to the main router, and 250mbps if connected to a satellite device.
If you can't run ethernet cables, you'd preferrably want a tri-band wifi system like the one in this deal as it will allow you get close to 500mbps (or upto 800mbps if you upgrade your plan) everywhere. These devices are much more expensive. This deal is only for the router unit and you'll have to find a satellite unit from somewhere else.

[KillerkratZ] If your house already has a wired backhaul setup, and you can get each of these connected via Ethernet then an easier solution is to change the router to access point mode
https://kb.netgear.com/31218/How-do-I-configure-my-Orbi-router-to-act-as-an-access-point
[YpeKiYay] Be aware that when doing that, you will not have a mesh with a single ssid across the router and satellites in your mesh. With access point you will need to use a different ssid for each router as it will not be a mesh. It will work fine if you are not fussed about the mesh functionality.
[YpeKiYay] Mobileciti $119 free shipping no further discount that i could find. Ebay $114 as per this post or $111 with ebay plus
[freeshipping] I had some of these Orbi units for a while and unfortunately they weren't the best of experience for me. Slow app performance and regular disconnections where I would have to reset very often. We tried a lot of solutions to solve these but yeah just personal experience. Now we're on a Deco Tri-Band system and works super well.
